$comment: Monaco Legend ET33/ET35/ET36 - Layer 2 corpus registered packet. Binds the exact verified corpus (JSONL SHA-256) and every corpus-level expectation the 2026-08-21 Final Validation Report proved. The corpus file is founder-held and staged at ingest time; this manifest never grows a hand-typed lot list. ET36 result prices are website Result (Premium) values under explicit semantic quarantine: they are never written to a realized-result field. sale chronology comes from the corpus's explicit chronological_position marker, never from date comparison at read time.

price_semantics: Monaco website displays 'Result (Premium)'. ET36 page does not explicitly state VAT basis. Preserve raw displayed value. Do not map to hammer_price and do not apply a 1.04 conversion. Historical cross-source evidence and Monaco premium terms indicate a VAT-basis distinction is plausible; semantic review remains required.

ET36.statement: No official ET36 result sheet was available in this acquisition. Website Result (Premium) values are source-native, on a different premium basis (documented 1.04 relationship: 1.30 TTC vs 1.25 ex-VAT premium factors), and remain quarantined. Sold outcomes ingest without realized prices until a founder semantics ruling releases them through the governed correction chain.

estimates_omission_sentence: Monaco published pre-sale estimates for these lots; estimates are deliberately not captured in this evidence layer (the schema does not model them, and realized prices are never used to carry them).
